_source: Cephalofair's updated Jaws of the Lion character sheets (crossover sheets in the Frosthaven format), transcribed by hand on 2026-11-18 from the owner's copies (P:/Guido/boardgames/Worldhaven/characters/jotl/character-perks/x-over/<Class> Sheet.jpg). One entry per perk line; n = boxes of a repeatable perk (each box is one entry, applied on its own); a text starting with [double] is one perk that needs two ticks. Cards: '+0' '+1' '+2' '+3' '-1' '-2' are plain cards, other names are decorated faces (the art slugs of scripts/games/perks.js, decoded by tools/perks-decode.mjs), 'u:<code>' a unique card. Read by tools/build-xover-perks.mjs.

Hatchet.text: Hasty Pick-up: Once each scenario, during your turn, if the Favorite is in a hex on the map, you may %use%%air% to return it to its ability card

Demolitionist.text: Replace one +1 card with two +2 cards
Add two +0 "All adjacent enemies suffer %damage% 1" cards
Ignore scenario effects and remove one -1 card
[double] Remodeling: Whenever you rest while adjacent to a wall or obstacle, you may place an obstacle in an empty hex within %range% 2 (of you)

Red Guard.text: Replace one +0 card and one +1 card with two +1 "%shield% 1" cards
Ignore item - 1 effects and add two +1 cards
[double] Brilliant Aegis: Whenever you are attacked, you may %use%%light% to gain %shield% 1 for the attack and have the attacker gain disadvantage for the attack

Voidwarden.text: Grave Defense: Whenever you rest, you may %use%%icedark% to give %ward% to one ally who has %poison%
